title: Meta prepares to undo Manus acquisition after China ban, WSJ reports
title_zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，Meta 准备在中国禁令后撤消对 Manus 的收购
summary: Meta Platforms is preparing to unwind its acquisition of artificial intelligence startup Manus after ‌China blocked the deal on national security grounds, the ‌Wall Street Journal reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据《华尔街日报》周一援引知情人士的话报道，在中国以国家安全为由阻止交易后，Meta Platforms 正准备取消对人工智能初创公司 Manus 的收购。

title: Alphabet earnings on tap with Gemini, AI spending updates in focus with stock near record high
title_zh: Alphabet 的盈利与 Gemini 密切相关，人工智能支出更新成为焦点，股价接近历史新高
summary: Google will report its first quarter earnings after the bell on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 谷歌将于周三盘后公布第一季度收益。

title: Microsoft keeps stake, loses exclusive access in new OpenAI agreement
title_zh: 微软保留股份，但失去新 OpenAI 协议的独家访问权
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) have amended their agreement to allow the private AI developer to partner with Microsoft's competitors.
summary_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 和 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 修改了协议，允许私人人工智能开发商与微软的竞争对手合作。

title: Elon Musk vs. Sam Altman: What to know about the OpenAI case
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 与萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman)：关于 OpenAI 案例的了解
summary: Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) CEO Elon Musk is meeting OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman in court this week over an alleged breach of the private artificial intelligence (AI) developer's nonprofit mission. Musk is also a co-founder of OpenAI.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 和 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 本周将在法庭上与 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 会面，因涉嫌违反这家私人人工智能 (AI) 开发商的非营利...

title: Microsoft earnings: What Wall Street is watching around AI, capex

summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is among the Magnificent Seven tech companies reporting quarterly results this week, currently scheduled to release earnings after the closing bell on Wednesday, April 29.
summary_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 是本周公布季度业绩的七大科技公司之一，目前计划在 4 月 29 日星期三收盘后发布财报。

title: US stocks: Will Mag 7 earnings be make-or-break for market rally?
title_zh: 美股：Mag 7 财报是否会影响市场反弹？
summary: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) are mixed heading into Monday's closing bell as investors gear up for an eventful trading week: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), Amazon (AMZN), Apple (AAPL), Meta Platforms (META), and Microsoft (MSFT) are all scheduled to report quarterly earnings result...
summary_zh: 美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在周一收盘前涨跌互现，投资者为本周多事的交易做好准备：Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）、亚马逊（AMZN）、苹果（AAPL）、Meta Platforms（META）和微软（MSFT）均计划公布季度盈利结果...

summary_zh: 英特尔股票 2.5 年的往返之旅将人工智能市场最热门的卷土重来故事之一变成了一个警示故事。

title: Why Fox Business Network's Charles Payne has owned Apple stock for more than 30 years

summary: Apple has been a long-term winner for many investors.
